_comment: Docs manifest read by assets/docs/docs.js. pages: sidebar and prev/next order. legacy: old single-page anchors (docs#<old>) -> new ?p= URLs; keep forever, the app's older builds open them. recipes: cards for <div class="recipe-cards" data-set="widgets|alerts">.

pages.title: Get started
pages.description: Install Desktap Agent, pair your iPhone or iPad and make a first button that runs a script on your Mac and changes its own look.
pages.summary: Install the agent, pair the phone and make a button that changes itself.

pages.title: Live widgets
pages.description: Keep a Desktap button current with a startup script: a plain live widget, where errors show, Button IDs, the live look and how often to update.
pages.summary: Startup scripts that keep a button current: values, colors, errors and Button IDs.

pages.title: SVG faces
pages.description: Draw a Desktap button in SVG and make it glide: a first face that moves, a start state, sizes and the turned phone, checks and icons from design tools.
pages.summary: Draw a button in SVG and make it glide from one frame to the next.

pages.title: Button logic
pages.description: Give a Desktap button logic: taps change state and a startup script draws it. Switches, timers, counters, several buttons and long press.
pages.summary: Taps change state, the loop draws it: switches, timers, counters and long press.

pages.title: Notifications
pages.description: Send notifications from a script to the phone and the Mac, with action buttons, and send them only when something changes.
pages.summary: Alerts with action buttons, sent once when something changes.

pages.title: Scenes and sound
pages.description: One loop that draws a scene across many Desktap buttons, widgets that move with the music, and motion that never stops.
pages.summary: One loop for many buttons, music levels and motion that never stops.

pages.title: Recipes: live widgets
pages.description: Copyable live widgets for Desktap, plain and drawn: each with its full zsh script, where it goes and what to change.
pages.summary: Copyable live widgets, plain and drawn, each with a full zsh script.

pages.title: Recipes: timers, alerts and triggers
pages.description: Copyable Desktap recipes that keep state, send notifications or react to programs on your Mac: timers, long jobs and hooks.
pages.summary: Timers, long jobs and hooks: recipes that remember, notify and react.

pages.title: Working from your Mac
pages.description: Move code to the phone, test a script in Terminal, drive Desktap buttons from hooks and cron, and use the agent’s windows on the Mac.
pages.summary: Test scripts in Terminal, drive buttons from hooks and cron, use the agent’s windows.

pages.title: How scripts run
pages.description: Reference: how Desktap Agent runs button scripts. Environment variables, lifecycle, time limits and stopping, permissions, zsh and AppleScript.
pages.summary: Environment, lifecycle, time limits, permissions, zsh and AppleScript.

pages.title: Script API
pages.description: Reference for the Desktap Agent API that button scripts call: endpoints, fields, answers, errors and limits.
pages.summary: Endpoints, fields, answers, errors and limits of the agent’s API.

pages.title: SVG reference
pages.description: Reference for Desktap SVG faces: supported SVG, what is not drawn, what glides and what cross-fades, errors and warnings, sizes.
pages.summary: Supported SVG, what is not drawn, what glides, errors and sizes.

pages.title: Troubleshooting
pages.description: Find what you see or the exact error text and fix it: buttons, startup scripts, the API, SVG faces, notifications and AI apps.
pages.summary: What you see or the exact error text, its cause and the fix.

pages.title: Use with an AI app
pages.description: Connect Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Codex to Desktap, review its changes on the phone and install the widget skill.
pages.summary: Connect an AI app, review its changes on the phone, add the widget skill.

recipes.title: Free disk space
recipes.summary: Shows the free space on your Mac's startup disk as the button's title, checked every 10 seconds.

recipes.title: A number from the web
recipes.summary: Puts a price, a temperature or any other number from a web API in the button's title, and refreshes it once a minute.

recipes.title: Dark Mode switch
recipes.summary: A tap switches the Mac between light and dark; the button shows the mode, even when you change it in System Settings.

recipes.title: CPU ring
recipes.summary: Fills a ring with the CPU load, green, orange from 50% and red from 80%, and glides to each new value.

recipes.title: Memory gauge
recipes.summary: Shows the memory in use as a tall gauge, with the percentage and gigabytes below. The gauge lies on its side when the phone turns.

recipes.title: Network speed
recipes.summary: Tracks the download speed: the number in large type and a chart of about the last 22 seconds that scrolls left without stopping.

recipes.title: System dashboard
recipes.summary: Fits three readings onto one Large button: CPU load as a ring, memory as a bar and a chart of CPU load over about 22 seconds.

recipes.title: Analog clock
recipes.summary: Draws a clock with hour and minute hands, a second hand that sweeps without stopping, and the date below.

recipes.title: Music spectrum
recipes.summary: Twenty bars follow the sound your Mac plays, about 11 frames a second, and rest while the button is off screen.

recipes.title: Focus timer
recipes.summary: Tap to start 25 minutes or cancel; the button counts down and carries on after a reconnect. A long press adds 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Low disk space alert
recipes.summary: Shows the free space on the startup disk and warns your phone and Mac once when it drops below 10 GB.

recipes.title: Pomodoro on two buttons
recipes.summary: Start/Stop on one button, a countdown ring on the next: 25 minutes of work, a 5-minute break, a notification in between.

recipes.title: Long job with a report
recipes.summary: Tap to start a deploy that may take ten minutes. The button counts the time, and a notification reports the result.

recipes.title: Claude Code needs input
recipes.summary: When Claude Code waits for you, a hook turns the button red and names the project. A tap or your next prompt clears it.

recipes.title: Tell me when a command finishes
recipes.summary: Put tellme in front of a long Terminal command. When it ends, your phone and your Mac show its result and how long it took.
